raw_message.reasoning:
I see - the bump subcommand has a nested structure where you need to specify a type (major/minor/patch/prerelease/build). When called without any argument, argparse complains because no positional argument is provided.

The requirement says: "When the bump subcommand is called without specific arguments, it must print the help text for that subcommand and exit gracefully."

So when `semver bump` is called (without major/minor/etc.), it should show the help. Currently, the issue is that the `--type` argument has a default but when no argument is given at all, argparse throws an error.

Let me look at how the createparser function sets up the bump subcommand.
